description:
🌊 Bullied and lonely orphan Liora is different from everyone in the coastal town. Hidden deep inside her body lies the powerful Star Power that keeps the whole ocean balanced.
Karon, the cruel demon lord of the abyss, wants this power to break the barrier and rule all seven seas. He takes the wounded Liora down to the dark abyss. He pretends to be her only protector and marks her soul with a dark contract. The spell tricks her into relying only on him.
Slowly, Liora grows attached to him, until the heir of the sea god Elior arrives and reveals the terrible truth: she is the missing Star Princess. The contract is nothing but a shackle that drains her life.
When the demon tries to forcefully steal her power, Liora wakes her true starlight. She rips the soul contract to pieces and fights side by side with Elior. Together, they seal the demon back into the deep trench.
At last, Liora returns to the sea kingdom, finds her people, and builds a bond of equal love with Elior.
#DarkSeaFantasy #StarPrincess #DemonBetrayal #FemaleLeadRevenge #FantasyRomance
